w10_T4_001984: A candy shop had 71 jars of gumballs on display for the fall fair. w10_T4_001985: In the morning, Camille had 232 photographs printed for the school yearbook, while her co-editor Ben had 60 photos of his own to sort. w10_T4_001988: Priya had 164 buttons in her craft box, while her classmate Diego had 90 buttons in his. A craft store trade turned every button she had into 6 buttons. w10_T4_001993: A beekeeper had 55 frames of honeycomb ready in the spring. He mentioned a dozen new gloves were ordered for the season, though that had nothing to do with the honeycomb count. w10_T4_001995: In the morning, a bookstore had 196 posters ready for a comic convention booth. By midday, a printer delivered 64 more posters. w10_T4_001999: Isabella had $183 saved for a school trip, while her friend Noah had $95 saved for the same trip. Isabella earned $65 more from a bake sale, then spent $12 on trip supplies. w10_T4_002002: Liam had $232 saved toward a new guitar, while his brother Kai had $150 saved for a drum set. A summer job bonus turned every dollar Liam had into 2 dollars. w10_T4_002005: Grace had 56 beads in her bracelet-making kit, while her friend Nora had 40 beads in hers. Grace used 8 beads to finish a small bracelet, then lost 7 beads that rolled under the couch. w10_T4_002008: In the morning, a farmer had 109 baskets of apples picked from the orchard. By midday, a bulk harvest turned every basket into 6 baskets. w10_T4_002010: A furniture store had 155 chairs in the warehouse before a big sale. A shipment of 30 tables also arrived that day, but that had nothing to do with the chair count. w10_T4_002011: In the morning, Jonah had 12 marbles in his pocket, while his friend Eli had 30 marbles in his. By midday, a marble machine turned every marble Jonah had into 6 marbles. w10_T4_002016: In the morning, a movie theater had 234 boxes of candy in the concession stock. By midday, 28 boxes were sold during the matinee. w10_T4_002018: In the morning, a construction site had 212 bricks stacked and ready. w10_T4_002019: A charity clothing drive had 225 coats collected before winter. The organizer mentioned that 40 scarves were also donated separately, though that had nothing to do with the coat count. w10_T4_002021: A candle maker had 22 finished candles ready for a craft fair. She mentioned that 15 extra wicks were also packed, though that had nothing to do with the candle count. w10_T4_002022: A city park had 176 tulip bulbs planted in the spring garden. A volunteer group planted 73 more bulbs the next week, and a garden club added 9 more. w10_T4_002029: A juice stand had 126 oranges delivered for the weekend festival. w10_T4_002038: A puzzle company had 114 boxes of jigsaw puzzles in a warehouse. A late shipment added 5 more boxes. Then 5 boxes were damaged in a forklift accident and discarded.
